{"actor_id":"EO:8357","char_end":19140,"char_start":17255,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":10237,"char_start":9780,"text":"I I\nUnder the authority vested in me by \nsection 1  (b) of Part I  of Reorganization \nPlan No. I I 1  (effective July 1, 1939, by \nPublic Resolution approved June 7, 1939, \n53 Stat. 1431), and in effectuation of the \nprovisions of subdivisions (2), (3), and \n(4) of that section, I  hereby prescribe\nthe following regulations pertaining to \nofficers designated by the Secretary of \nCommerce and the Secretary of Agricul­\nture under the said subdivisions:\n1."},{"char_end":17254,"char_start":16666,"text":"Classified positions in the Custo­\ndian Service and at the Coast Guard De­\npot, Curtis Bay, Maryland, when filled by \nthe promotion of unclassified laborers \nappointed under the Labor Regulations, \nsubject to the approval of the Commis­\nsion.”\nThis order is recommended by the Civil \nService Commission in view of the agree­\nment by the Treasury Department that \nhereafter unclassified laborer positions in \nthese services where Labor Regulations \nare in effect will be filled through ap­\npointment from appropriate classified \nregisters as provided in section 3 of Civil \nService Rule H."},{"char_end":24176,"char_start":23345,"text":"Doc. 40-918; Piled, March 4, 1940;\n2:47 p. m.]\nEXECUTIVE ORDER\nAmendment  op Executive  O rder N o. 8283 \nof November 9,1939, Amending  Section \n6 of Civil  Service Rule  n\nBy virtue of the authority vested in me \nby the Civil Service Act (22 Stat. 403), it \nis ordered that the penultimate para­\ngraph of Executive Order No. 8283 of\nNovember 9, 1939, be, and it is hereby, \namended to read*as follows:\n“The second proviso  of the said section \n6 of Civil Service Rule n  as herein \namended shall also apply to the incum­\nbents of positions heretofore or here­\nafter covered into the classified (competi­\ntive) service by section 1  of Executive \nOrder No. 7916 of June 24, 1938, and sec­\ntion 3 of that order is modified accord­\ningly, effective as of November 9, 1939.”\nThis order is recommended by the Civil \nService Commission."},{"char_end":24756,"char_start":24633,"text":"This order shall become effective upon \nthe date of the official filing of the plat \nof the resurvey of the lands involved."},{"char_end":34300,"char_start":33919,"text":"The foregoing action shall be effective \nFebruary 21, 1940, except that financial \nstatements filed as a part of any regis­\ntration statement, application for regis­\ntration, or report filed with the Commis­\nsion prior to June 1, 1940, may be pre­\npared in accordance with the applicable \nrequirements as in effect immediately \nprior to the adoption of Regulation S-X \n[Part 210]'."},{"char_end":36545,"char_start":36486,"text":"The foregoing action shall be effective \nFebruary 21, 1940."},{"char_end":44227,"char_start":43316,"text":"Part 210 shall govern the form and con­\ntent of all financial statements required \nto be filed as part of—\n(a) Registration statements under the \nSecurities Act of 1933 \\ filed on Form \nA-2;\n(b) Applications for registration of se­\ncurities under the Securities Exchange \nAct of 19342 , filed on Form 8-A, 8-B, 10, \n11, 13, 14, 15, 17, 22, 23, or 24;\n(c) Supplemental or periodic reports \nunder Section 13 of the Securities Ex­\nchange Act of 1934 [Sec. 13, 48 Stat. 894; \n15 U.S.C., 78ml, filed on Form 10-K, \n11-K, 13— K, 14-K, 15-K, 17-K, or 24-K; \nand,\n(d) Supplemental or periodic reports \nunder Section 15 (d) of the Securities \nExchange Act of 1934 [Sec. 15, 48 Stat. \n895; Sec. 3, 49 Stat. 1377; Sec. 1, 52 Stat. \n1070; 15 U.S.C., 78o, Sup. m  and 15 \nU.S.C., 78o-31, filed on Form 1-MD or \n4-MD.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 1-01, \neffective Feb. 21, 19401\n§  210.1-02 Definitions of terms used in  \npart 210."},{"char_end":48521,"char_start":47722,"text":"Totally-held subsidiary. —The term \n“totally-held subsidiary” means a sub­\nsidiary (a) substantially all of the out­\nstanding securities of which are owned \nby its parent and/or the parent’s other \ntotally-held subsidiaries, and (b) which \ndoes not owe to any person other than \nits parent and/or the parent’s other to­\ntally-held subsidiaries any debt of an \namount which is material in relation to \nthe particular subsidiary: Provided, how­\never, That the existence of any indebted­\nness incurred in the ordinary course of \nbusiness which is not overdue and which \nmatures within one year from the date \nof its creation, whether evidenced by se­\ncurities or not, shall not prevent a sub­\nsidiary from being deemed a totally-held \nsubsidiary.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 1- \n02, effective Feb. 21, 19401"},{"char_end":49601,"char_start":49215,"text":"An accountant will \nnot be considered independent with re­\nspect to any person in whom he has any \nsubstantial interest, direct or indirect, or \nwith whom he is, or was during the period \nof report, connected as a promoter, un­\nderwriter, voting trustee, director, officer, \nor employee.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 2- \n01, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.2-02 Certification by account­\nants."},{"char_end":51393,"char_start":51148,"text":"(d) If certification is made by an in­\ndividual accountant, the above provi­\nsions as to accountants shall be read in \nthe singular.* [Regulation S-X, Rule\n2-02, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.2-03 Certification by foreign  \ngovernment auditors."},{"char_end":51891,"char_start":51395,"text":"Notwithstanding\nany requirements as to certification by \nindependent accountants, the financial \nstatements of any foreign governmental \nagency may be certified by the regular \nand customary auditing staff of the re­\nspective government, if public financial \nstatements of such governmental agency \nare customarily certified by such audit­\ning staff.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 2-03, \neffective Feb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.2-04 Certification of financial  \nstatements of persons other than the  \nregistrant."},{"char_end":52240,"char_start":51893,"text":"If a registrant is required to \nfile financial statements of any other \nperson, such statements need not be cer­\ntified if certification of such statements \nwould not be required if such person were \nitself a registrant.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 2-04, effective Peb. 21, 19401\nRULES OF GENERAL APPLICATION\n§ 210.3-01 Form, order, and terminol­\nogy."},{"char_end":52547,"char_start":52241,"text":"Financial statements may be filed \nin such form and order, and may use \nsuch generally accepted terminology, as \nwill best indicate their significance and \ncharacter in the light of the provisions \napplicable thereto.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 3-01, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-02 Inapplicable captions."},{"char_end":53423,"char_start":53251,"text":"The reason for the \nomission of any schedule shall be \nstated.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 3-03, \neffective Feb. 21,19401\n§ 210.3-04 Omission of substantially  \nidentical notes."},{"char_end":53891,"char_start":53424,"text":"If notes covering sub­\nstantially the same subject matter are \nrequired with respect to two or more \nfinancial statements, it will suffice to in­\nclude the required information in a note \nto one of such statements, provided that \na clear and specific reference thereto is \nmade in each of the other statements \nwith respect to which the note is re­\nquired.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 3-04, \neffective Feb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-05 Omission of names of cer­\ntain subsidiaries."},{"char_end":54380,"char_start":54132,"text":"Reasonable grouping of such sub­\nsidiaries may be made with an explana­\ntory group caption which shall state the\nnumber of subsidiaries included in the \ngroup.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 3-05. \neffective Peb. 21 19401\n§ 210.3-06 Additional information."},{"char_end":54978,"char_start":54674,"text":"This section shall be ap­\nplicable to all statements required to be \nfiled, including copies of statements re­\nquired to be filed in the first instance \nwith other governmental agencies.* \n[Regulation S-X, Rule 3-06, effective \nPeb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3— 07 Changes in accounting  \nprinciples and practices."},{"char_end":55476,"char_start":54980,"text":"If any signifi­\ncant change in accounting principle or \npractice has been made at the beginning \nof or during any period covered by the \nprofit and less statements filed, a state­\nment as to the change shall be given in \na note to the appropriate statement, and \nif the change substantially affects proper \ncomparison with the preceding fiscal \nperiod, the necessary explanation.* \n[Regulation S-X, Rule 3-07, effective \nPeb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-08 Summary of accounting  \nprinciples and practices."},{"char_end":55897,"char_start":55645,"text":"In such \ncase specific references shall be made in \nthe appropriate financial statements to \nthe applicable portion of such single \nstatement.* [Regulation S-X, Rule\n3-08, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-09 Conversion of items in for­\neign currencies."},{"char_end":56159,"char_start":55899,"text":"The basis of conversion \nof all items in foreign currencies shall be \nstated, and the amount and disposition \nof the resulting unrealized profit or loss \nshown, if significant.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 3-09, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-10 Opening balances."},{"char_end":56777,"char_start":56161,"text":"In­\nstructions which permit the balance of \nan account at the beginning of the period \nfor which financial statements are being \nfiled to be “ as per the accounts” shall \nnot be applicable with respect to compa­\nnies which have previously filed financial \nstatements under the Securities Act of \n19331  or the Securities Exchange Act of \n1934.* As to such companies, however, \nbalances as per accounts may be taken \nas of the close of the most recent period \nfor which certified financial statements \nare on file.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 3-10, \neffective Feb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-11 Valuation and qualifying  \nreserves."},{"char_end":57443,"char_start":57138,"text":"=== PDF page 9 of 27 ===\nF E D E R A L REGISTER, Wednesday, March 6, 1940 957\ntization, or retirements provided by a \npublic utility company in respect of its \nassets other than current assets.* \n[Regulation S-X, Rule 3-11, effective \nPeb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-12 Basis  of determining  \namounts— book value."},{"char_end":57817,"char_start":57571,"text":"The term “book \nvalue” will not be sufficiently explanatory \nunless, in a particular instruction, it is \nstated to be acceptable with respect to a \nparticular item.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 3-12, effective Peb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.3-13 Current assets."},{"char_end":58294,"char_start":57900,"text":"However, \ngenerally recognized trade practices may \nbe followed with respect to items such \nas instalment receivables or inventories \nlong in process, provided an appropriate \nexplanation of the circumstances is \nmade and, if practicable, an estimate is \ngiven of the amount not realizable within \none year.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 3-13, \neffective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-14 Current liabilities."},{"char_end":58707,"char_start":58396,"text":"However, generally rec­\nognized trade practices may be followed \nwith respect to items such as customers’ \ndeposits and deferred income, provided \nan appropriate explanation of the cir­\ncumstances is made.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 3-14, effective Peb. 21, 1940]\ni 210.3-15 Reacquired evidences of  \nindebtedness."},{"char_end":59258,"char_start":58859,"text":"However, reacquired evidences of indebt­\nedness held for pension and other special \nfunds not related to the particular issue \nmay be carried as assets of such funds, \nprovided that there be stated paren­\nthetically the amount of such evidences of \nindebtedness, the cost thereof, and the \namount at winch carried.* [Regulation \nS-X, Rule 3-15, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.3-16 Reacquired shares."},{"char_end":59602,"char_start":59260,"text":"Re­\nacquired shares, if significant in amount, \nshall be shown separately as a deduction \nfrom capital shares, or from the total of \ncapital shares and surplus, or from sur­\nplus, at either par or stated value, or \ncost, as circumstances require.* [Regu­\nlation S-X, Rule 3-16, effective Peb. 21, \n19401\n§ 210.3-17 Discount on capital shares."},{"char_end":59950,"char_start":59605,"text":"Discount on capital shares, if significant \nin amount, shall be shown separately as \na deduction from capital shares or from \nsurplus, as circumstances require, with \nan indication of what provisions have \nbeen made for writing off this item.* \n[Regulation S-X, Rule 3-17, effective \nPeb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.3-18 General notes to balance  \nsheets.."},{"char_end":62421,"char_start":62190,"text":"In the case of \nguarantees of securities of other issuers \na reference to the appropriate schedule \nshall be included.* [Regulation S-X, \nRule 3-18, effective Peb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.3-19 General notes to profit  \nand loss statements."},{"char_end":64153,"char_start":63186,"text":"State the \npolicy followed during the period for \nwhich profit and loss statements are filed \nwith respect to:\n(1) The provision for depreciation, de­\npletion, and obsolescence of physical \nproperties, or reserves created in lieu \nthereof, including the methods and, if \npracticable, the rates used in computing \nthe annual amounts;\n(2) The provision for depreciation and \namortization of intangibles, or reserves \ncreated in lieu thereof, including the \nmethods and, if practicable, the rates \nused in computing the annual amounts;\n(3) The accounting treatment for \nmaintenance, repairs, renewals, and bet­\nterments; and\n(4) The adjustment of the accumu­\nlated reserves for depreciation, depletion, \nobsolescence, amortization, or reserves in \nlieu thereof, at the time properties are \nretired or otherwise disposed of.* [Regu­\nlation S-X, Rule 3-19, effective Peb. 21, \n1940]\nCONSOLIDATED AND COMBINED STATEMENTS\n§ 210.4-01 Application of  §§ 210.4-01 \nto 210.4-12."},{"char_end":64372,"char_start":64154,"text":"These sections shall govern \nthe preparation of consolidated and \ncombined statements.* [Regulation \nS-X, Rule 4-01, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.4-02 Consolidated statements of  \nthe registrant and its subsidiaries."},{"char_end":65421,"char_start":64374,"text":"The \nregistrant shall follow in the consoli­\ndated statements principles of inclusion \nor exclusion which will clearly exhibit \nthe financial condition and results of \noperations of the registrant and its sub­\nsidiaries: Provided, however,  That—\n(a) The registrant shall not consoli­\ndate any subsidiary which is not a ma­\njority-owned subsidiary;\n(b) If the statements of a subsidiary \nare as of a date or for periods different \nfrom those of the registrant, such sub­\nsidiary may be consolidated only if all \nthe following conditions exist: (1) Such \ndifference is not more than 93 days; (2) \nthe closing date of the subsidiary is ex­\npressly indicated; (3) the necessity for \nthe use of different closing dates is \nbriefly explained; and (4) any changes \nin the respective fiscal periods of the \nregistrant and the subsidiary made dur­\ning the period of report are clearly indi­\ncated, together with the manner of \ntreatment.* [Regulation S-X, Rule\n4-02, effective Peb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-03 Group statements of sub­\nsidiaries not consolidated."},{"char_end":66109,"char_start":65991,"text":"Rule 4-03, effective Peb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.4-04 Statement as to principle  \nof consolidation or combination fol­\nlowed."},{"char_end":66988,"char_start":66678,"text":"If the answer to the fore­\ngoing is in the affirmative, the names of \nsuch persons shall be given.* [Regula­\ntion S-X, Rule 4-04, effective Peb. 21, \n1940]\n§ 210.4-05 Reconciliation of invest­\nment of parent in subsidiaries and  \nequity of parent in net assets of subsi­\ndiaries— (a) Consolidated subsidiaries."},{"char_end":68049,"char_start":67537,"text":"A \nstatement shall be made of the amount \nof any difference between the invest­\nment of the parent and its consolidated \nsubsidiaries, as shown by their books, \nin the unconsolidated subsidiaries for \nwhich statements are filed and the \nequity of such persons in the net assets \nof such unconsolidated subsidiaries, as \nshown by the books of the latter.* \n[Regulation S-X, Rule 4-05, effective \nPeb. 21, 19401\n§ 210.4-06 Reconciliation of dividends \nreceived from, and earnings of, uncon­\nsolidated subsidiaries."},{"char_end":68586,"char_start":68050,"text":"The proportion of \nthe sum of, or difference between, cur­\nrent earnings or losses and the dividends \ndeclared or paid by unconsolidated sub­\nsidiaries that is applicable to the parent \nand its consolidated subsidiaries shall \nbe set forth in a note to each consolidated \nprofit and loss statement.* [Regulation\nS-X, Rule 4-06, effective Feb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-07 Minority interests,  (a) \nMinority interests in the net worth of \nsubsidiaries consolidated, unless nominal \nin amount, shall be shown in each con­\nsolidated balance sheet."},{"char_end":68979,"char_start":68694,"text":"(b) The aggregate amount of profit or \nloss accruing to minority interests shall, \nunless nominal in amount, be stated sep­\narately in each consolidated profit and \nloss statement.* [Regulation S-X, Rule \n4-07, effective Feb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-08 Intercompany items and  \ntransactions."},{"char_end":69546,"char_start":69425,"text":"Rule 4-09, effective Feb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-10 Special requirements as  \nto registrants which are investment  \ncompanies."},{"char_end":70479,"char_start":70006,"text":"(c) Consolidated or combined state­\nments filed for subsidiaries not con­\nsolidated with the registrant shall not \ninclude any investment companies un­\nless accompanied by consolidating or \ncombining statements which set forth \nthe individual statements of each in­\ncluded investment company which is a \nsignificant subsidiary. * [ Regulation S-X, \nRule 4-10, effective Feb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-11 Special requirements as to  \nregistrants which are batik holding com­\npanies."},{"char_end":71342,"char_start":70931,"text":"(c) Consolidated or combined state­\nments filed for subsidiaries not consoli­\ndated with the registrant shall not \ninclude any bank holding companies un­\nless accompanied by consolidating or \ncombining statements which set forth \nthe individual statements of each \nincluded bank holding company subsid­\niary.* [Regulations S-X, Rule 4-il, \neffective Feb. 21, 1940]\n§ 210.4-12 Special requirements as to  \nbanks."},{"char_end":72094,"char_start":71811,"text":"Except as pro­\nvided in the preceding sentence, state­\nments of banks shall not be included in \nany consolidated or combined state­\nments.* [Regulation S-X, Rule 4-12, \neffective Feb. 21, 1940]\nCOMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL COMPANIES\n§ 210.5^-01 Application of  §§ 210.5-01 \nto 210.5-04."},{"char_end":72774,"char_start":72486,"text":"Finan­\ncial statements and schedules filed for \nbank holding companies shall be pre­\npared in accordance with these sections \nexcept that §§ 210.9-01 to 210.9-04, inclu­\nsive, shall be applicable thereto.* [Reg­\nulation S-X, Rule 5-01, effective Feb. 21, \n1940]\n§ 210.5-02 Balance sheets."},{"char_end":82154,"char_start":81599,"text":"(b) An analysis of each surplus ac­\ncount setting forth the information pre­\nscribed in § 210.11-02 shall be given for \neach period for which
